result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Sparkling may assign without consent to affiliates and transaction successors; Garman requires Sparkling’s consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and cannot assign to a Sparkling competitor; and Sparkling’s change of control creates no termination right. The Section 20(d) cross-reference appropriately resolves the conflicting assignment restriction in Section 3(c) without disturbing its separate restrictions on transferring, leasing, exporting or sublicensing the Work. The additional change-of-control protections against suspension, repricing or variation are closely related anti-circumvention protections and do not materially alter unrelated commercial intent. The drafting is clear and professional.
